query:
SELECT 
  investment_type, 
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(deal_size_usd AS DECIMAL(20,2)))/1000000000, 2) as total_billion_usd
FROM investments
GROUP BY investment_type
ORDER BY count DESC;
